may_do: help sims declare constraints and controls
help docs distinguish root constraints from candidate fences
may_not_do: promote a candidate fence by listing it

roots.forbidden_import: continuum, infinite path family, unbounded witness, infinite registry, unbounded claim
roots.cs_enforcement: bounded data structures, finite grids, finite result artifacts, explicit claim ceilings
roots.qit_translation: finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, finite density matrices, finite instruments, finite path sums

roots.forbidden_import: commuting scalar update treated as sufficient
roots.cs_enforcement: ordered traces, reversed-order controls, order-shuffled controls
roots.qit_translation: noncommuting operators, CPTP channel composition, Kraus histories, commutator gaps

derived_constraints.qit_translation: state equivalence must be relative to distinguishability under probes
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: same label can hide distinguishable states under a second probe

derived_constraints.forbidden_import: single coordinate or scalar equality used as sameness
derived_constraints.qit_translation: rho and sigma are equivalent only relative to a named probe family and tolerance
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: states equal under one readout are separated by another noncommuting readout

derived_constraints.human_statement: Probability requires a state plus probe.
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: same rho gives different distributions under noncommuting probes

derived_constraints.human_statement: Time and causality are not primitive.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: global clock or causal arrow not built from order-sensitive composition
derived_constraints.qit_translation: temporal-like order must arise from noncommuting process composition

derived_constraints.human_statement: Coordinates and metric distance are not primitive.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: chart distance treated as physical fact
derived_constraints.qit_translation: use invariant distances or named chart-dependent readouts with controls
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: coordinate distance changes under chart while trace distance remains controlled

derived_constraints.human_statement: Closure, identity, inverse, and group structure must be earned.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: operator family called a group without proof
derived_constraints.qit_translation: channel family composition, CPTP completeness, inverse availability checked explicitly
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: amplitude damping lacks inverse and fails group closure

derived_constraints.human_statement: Every claim needs a bounded witness.
derived_constraints.qit_translation: finite carrier, finite probe family, finite path family, finite receipt
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: claim rejected or demoted when no finite receipt can be named

derived_constraints.human_statement: Noncommuting states cannot be freely copied or broadcast.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: copying a noncommuting carrier as a primitive runtime operation
derived_constraints.qit_translation: no-cloning/no-broadcasting constraints for noncommuting state sets
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: copy map fails for nonorthogonal or noncommuting states

derived_constraints.forbidden_import: best state or utility treated as primitive
derived_constraints.qit_translation: objective is D, S, I, I_c, evidence, or another named functional

derived_constraints.human_statement: The observer/probe is part of the modeled substrate.
derived_constraints.qit_translation: joint rho_AB, instrument updates, trace-out/back-action checks
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: probe state changes target reduced state

derived_constraints.human_statement: No single scalar ranks all states globally.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: entropy or purity used as total order
derived_constraints.qit_translation: vector/Pareto/multi-readout status required where scalar degeneracy exists
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: same scalar value hides operationally distinct states

derived_constraints.human_statement: Classical concepts must be re-proved after translation.
derived_constraints.forbidden_import: renaming a classical object as quantum without checking changed properties
derived_constraints.qit_translation: test property preservation under noncommuting finite carriers
derived_constraints.enforcement_gate: coherent information can be negative while classical mutual information is nonnegative

candidate_fences.human_statement: Subsystem cuts are constructed, not primitive.
candidate_fences.forbidden_import: A|B split assumed without cut construction
candidate_fences.qit_translation: factorization and cut state must be specified and tested under alternate cuts
candidate_fences.next_gate: same readout tested across block, interleaved, and mediator cuts

candidate_fences.human_statement: Classical Markov chains are baselines, not roots.
candidate_fences.forbidden_import: primitive real transition probabilities and total time order
candidate_fences.qit_translation: finite CPTP map or instrument iteration
candidate_fences.next_gate: CPTP path family separates behavior erased by classical Markov baseline

candidate_fences.human_statement: Classical Markov blankets are replaced by constructed cuts and mediators.
candidate_fences.forbidden_import: sharp classical blanket partition with primitive conditional independence
candidate_fences.qit_translation: A-M-B cut with noncommuting boundary operators and conditional information tests
candidate_fences.next_gate: mediator/cut test with product, dephased, and shuffled controls

candidate_fences.human_statement: A scalar readout is not automatically the object.
candidate_fences.forbidden_import: Axis0 or flux collapsed to one scalar by convenience
candidate_fences.qit_translation: structured readout family with degeneracy controls
candidate_fences.next_gate: scalar-equal states separated by vector/cut/process readouts

candidate_fences.human_statement: Smooth/continuous structure must be approximated or earned.
candidate_fences.forbidden_import: continuous gradient or field as root
candidate_fences.qit_translation: finite cell, graph, operator, or tensor approximation with scale checks
candidate_fences.next_gate: finite grid/lattice version reproduces claimed behavior with scale sensitivity reported

candidate_fences.forbidden_import: inverse dynamics or unitary-only picture when dissipative channels are present
candidate_fences.qit_translation: unitary, CPTP, and dissipative cases separated explicitly
candidate_fences.next_gate: irreversible channel fails inverse and changes basin/readout behavior
